description: This Python module provides helper classes and functions for building C++ extensions with pybind11, including support for different compilers, C++ standards, and parallel compilation.

classes.name: Pybind11Extension
classes.description: A custom extension class for building C++11+ modules with pybind11, supporting automatic C++ standard flags and platform-specific compiler options.

classes.name: build_ext
classes.description: A subclass of setuptools' build_ext that automatically detects the highest supported C++ standard for pybind11 extensions.

classes.name: ParallelCompile
classes.description: A utility class to enable parallel compilation of source files, with configurable threading and recompile logic.

methods.name: tmp_chdir
methods.description: Context manager for creating and switching to a temporary directory, then cleaning up.

methods.name: has_flag
methods.description: Checks if a given compiler supports a specific flag.

methods.name: auto_cpp_level
methods.description: Determines the highest supported C++ standard level (17, 14, or 11) for a given compiler.

methods.name: intree_extensions
methods.description: Generates pybind11 extension objects from source files located within a source tree, with optional package directory mapping.

methods.name: naive_recompile
methods.description: Decides whether to recompile a source file based on modification times, without header dependency checks.

methods.name: no_recompile
methods.description: Always returns True, indicating sources should always be recompiled.
